## Ancient Cuélebre (CR 20)

**XP** 307,200  
CE Gargantuan dragon  
**Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +36; **Aura** frightful presence (300 ft., DC 30)  


**Defense**


**AC** 38, touch 5, flat-footed 38 (–1 Dex, +33 natural, –4 size)  
**hp** 598 (26d12+286)  
**Fort** +25, **Ref** +16, **Will** +24  
**DR** 15/magic; **Immune** paralysis, sleep; **SR** 31  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., fly 250 ft. (clumsy)  
**Melee** bite +38 (4d6+22/19–20), tail slap +37 (4d6+22 plus grab), 2 wings +35 (2d8+7)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite and tail slap)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. cone, 20d6 acid damage, DC 33), crush (DC 33, 4d6+22), earthquake stomp (40-ft. radius, 10d6 bludgeoning damage, DC 33), constrict (1d8+12, tail slap), tail sweep (DC 31, 4d6+22)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 41, **Dex** 8, **Con** 31, **Int** 18, **Wis** 24, **Cha** 25  
**Base Atk** +26; **CMB** +45 (+49 grapple); **CMD** 54 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Flyby Attack, Greater Vital Strike, Hover, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (tail slap), Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
**Skills** Appraise +33, Climb +44, Fly +14, Intimidate +36, Knowledge (local) +33, Perception +36, Sense Motive +36, Stealth +16, Survival +36, Swim +44  
**Languages** Common, Draconic, Sphinx, Terran Cuélebres are serpentine dragons that live in caves, guarding their treasures and causing destruction to nearby settlements, farms, and livestock. They have bat-like wings, four clawed legs, and a powerful tail.
